svg.aria-label: How slop-scan reaches a verdict: 0 to 2 fingerprints is No, 3 to 5 is Some, 6 or more is Strong; the example site has 9
svg.text: Count the fingerprints that are present. One alone is a trend; the AI look is several together.
2 of them = Some. 3 or more = Strong, whatever the total.
